# Untap - Study App Blocker

> Quiz from your notes to unlock your phone. Turn distractions into study sessions.

## Product

Untap is a screen time control app for iPhone and Android that helps students focus by requiring them to answer quiz questions from their study notes before unlocking distracting apps.

**Core Feature**: Quiz-to-unlock - Upload study notes, try to open Instagram/TikTok, answer a quiz question correctly to unlock.

**Target Audience**: Students (high school, college), educators, parents of students.

**Platforms**: iOS (iPhone, iPad), Android

**Pricing**: Free tier with core features; paid plans with unlimited quiz banks and advanced analytics. Student discounts available.

- 4.8/5 average rating from 1,284 reviews
- 3.5 hours average daily screen time saved

## Real Testimonials

- Arjun (engineering student, Pune): reduced screen time from 7h to 1.8h/day
- Ravi M. (college student, Bengaluru): GPA increased 0.4 points
- Sofía G. (marketer, Madrid): still using after 8 weeks

## Product Features

- Quiz-to-unlock from study notes
- Open delays (5-30 seconds before app opens)
- Session limits (daily time caps per app)
- Hard locks (scheduled unavailability)
- Friend Lock (password-protected settings by trusted person)
- Prevent Uninstall
- Breathing exercises
- QR/NFC unlock options
- Math challenges
- Usage reports (daily, weekly, monthly)
- Focus mode
- Privacy-first (all data stays on device)

## Technology

- iOS: Uses Apple FamilyControls, ManagedSettings, DeviceActivity APIs
- Android: Native Android implementation
- No tracking, no analytics SDKs, no external servers
- Cross-platform sync
